# Tamper Signal

> Signed receipts for vibe-coded data pipelines. Every pipeline stage signs a receipt; verification reports a traffic light: green (chain intact), yellow (verifies, with caveats), red (broken at an exact link, with the totals delta). This proves continuity, not correctness: it can't tell you the data is right, but it can prove nobody changed it.

Install: `pip install tamper-signal` (Python 3.11+, CLI `receipts`) or `npm install tamper-signal` (Node 18.17+, CLI `tamper-signal`). Chains are interchangeable across the two stacks.

Period-over-period continuity: declare a signed tolerance at ingest (`--band`, `--settle`, `--bucket-column`) and recurring refreshes earn yellow caveats when recent data drifts past the band or settled data moves; `receipts diff` and `receipts log` read the auto-archived run history (weaker evidence than the chain).

## Writing

- [Blog](https://tampersignal.com/blog/): notes on keeping AI-built data pipelines honest
- [Your vibe-coded dashboard needs receipts](https://tampersignal.com/blog/your-vibe-coded-dashboard-needs-receipts.html): the pitch, longer; why AI-written data code fails silently and how a signed receipt at every step catches it
- [Your data is supposed to move](https://tampersignal.com/blog/your-data-is-supposed-to-move.html): tolerance bands and run history, so the light stays believable on a pipeline that refreshes every morning
- [Show your work](https://tampersignal.com/blog/show-your-work.html): why every dashboard built on verified data should ship a Data tab, the raw verified rows next to the charts
